datasets.title: Flooding in the Philippines on July 18, 2024
datasets.description: This dataset shows the actual extent of flooding in the Philippines caused by typhoons or tropical cyclones as of July 18, 2024, as observed through available satellite imagery. The dataset can be used to track the progression of floods over time, identify areas at risk, and assess the impact of these natural disasters on infrastructure, agriculture, and local populations.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/philippines-flood-20240718]
datasets.details: This dataset has not been validated using ground-truth data.

lineage.description: Satellite synthetic aperture radar (SAR) imagery from Sentinel-1 was processed by the Philippine Space Agency to detect and map the actual flood extent across the Philippines on July 18, 2024 following typhoon-induced flooding. The processed flood boundaries were delivered as both raster (PNG) and vector (shapefile) formats to enable temporal tracking and impact assessment.

sources.name: Philippine Space Agency
sources.description: Satellite image processing to delineate actual flood extent from Sentinel-1 SAR imagery on July 18, 2024, caused by tropical cyclone-induced precipitation and storm surge
